title: Paper plate clock with moving hands and minute marks
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y3 lessons 76, 77, 78, 79, 81, 82, 83, 84 (Paper plate clock with moving hands and minute marks (printable template))

blocks.text: Stick the clock face onto a paper plate. Cut a long minute hand and a short hour hand from card and join them to the centre with a split pin (an adult makes the hole).
